status: post-result correction of one synthetic-control expected count; exploratory diagnostic, not strict preregistration
question: Can either inherited N2 maximum-width model align the recorded prefix while v139R_C01_023 and v139R_C02_017 (both labelled S_slash_loop) emit the same string?
hypothesis: One deterministic positive-length substitution for the two recorded S_slash_loop occurrences, with all other declared assumptions retained.
reference_and_grouping_policy: Use all 12 scenarios verbatim. Count prefix endpoints, not full-reference fits. Four references x three groupings share six effective prefix cases; never claim independent trials.
mapping_policy: Retain all eight non-N2 active mappings verbatim; N2 is an unknown positive-length slot bounded by 1 or 8. Keep mapping_masked and other width constraints unchanged.
other_unknowns: All other unresolved slots remain independent. Visually distinguished crossed forms are not merged; uncertain U_ clusters and possible repeat-operator slots receive no new equality assignment.

controls.criterion: Without the pair equality, counts, target projections, N2 projections and endpoint histograms must exactly match all 24 expected_width_results in the pinned config.
A,B,A with one-letter slots against aba: one path with equal A; multicharacter X,q,X against abqab with widths1..2: one equal-X path.
A,B,A against abc: one independent path, zero equal-A paths. X,q,X against abqac: two independent prefix paths (endpoints 4 and 5), zero equal-X paths.
Mapping-masked tokens must not inherit a fixed key value.
A mismatched retained literal has no path with or without equality; empty histograms must be handled explicitly.

success_criterion: At least one equality-compatible path in a baseline-nonempty scenario. Record surviving paired values and crossed-sign outputs, but do not accept any new historical key value.
rejection_criterion: Zero equality-compatible paths in every baseline-nonempty scenario rejects only the conjunction of recorded sign-class identity, deterministic substitution, inherited anchors, exposed reference prefix and grouping/width assumptions. It does not reject historical plaintext alone.
inconclusive_criterion: A failed input hash, baseline comparison or synthetic control invalidates the new calculation; do not publish a research conclusion from it.
required_outputs: All 24 scenario/N2-bound records with baseline count, equality count and complete joint histogram of the two slash-loop outputs, endpoint counts and crossed-target outputs on surviving paths.
Compact summary over 12 named and six effective cases; distinguish duplicates.
Input/protocol/code hashes, commands and software version; preserve original bytes.
independent_check: A separately written augmented-state dynamic program must reproduce the enumeration-derived baseline/equality counts and joint slash-output histograms for all 24 records.
bounds: No plaintext repair, key repair, nulls, broader width family, language-model optimization or search for fluent text. Do not run either October7 experiment script or the 6144-ablation replay.
limitations: All reference wording, key assumptions and older diagnostic results were already exposed. This is a conditional model-consistency diagnostic, not blind validation.
Source glyph identity is a recorded annotation and has not been independently certified from pixels here.
No full-key or full-letter solution is inferred; successful remaining unknown slots need not be globally coherent.
Zero full-reference counts are structurally guaranteed by input length and are not an outcome or success criterion of this test.
History check covers published config/code/report and October7 wrapper. Personal-context retrieval and earlier ZIP bytes were unavailable; no claim of exhaustive novelty across private prior work.
ai_assistance: Codex selected the hypothesis, specified the protocol and checks; code and read-only review are AI-assisted, not human expert validation.

amendment.change: Correct X,q,X against abqac from one to two independent prefix paths (endpoints 4 and 5); zero equal-X paths unchanged.
amendment.reason: The original wording counted only the full endpoint, whereas the declared production and synthetic model admits prefix endpoints.
amendment.unchanged: No change to input bytes, binding pair, references, mappings, widths, production success/rejection criteria, solver algorithm or observed production counts.
amendment.initial_run_status: The calculation is retained verbatim for audit; the original synthetic-control wording was not satisfied, so it is not a valid conclusion under protocol v1.
amendment.snapshot: initial-run/ contains original protocol, results and three code files. These are audit bytes; current files provide the corrected reproducible workflow.
